    Data: NASA EONET. Each icon marks an event's most recent reported location. Drag to spin the globe, or use the globe button on the map to switch to a flat map. The glow around an icon shows the reported size: fire acreage and ice area are to scale, storm glow follows wind speed, and a faint halo means no size was reported. Place names come from GeoNames (CC BY 4.0): each event is matched to a nearby town of 5,000+ people (within 300 km).
